uiLanguage.name: Module language
uiLanguage.hint: The language of Roll Requests for you. Like Foundry follows the language of your Foundry interface.

theme.name: Look
theme.hint: Signature is warm and light, Foundry follows the dark look of Foundry. Applies to the request window, the roll window and the cards for you.

promptWindow.name: Open a roll window
promptWindow.hint: When the GM asks one of your characters to roll, a small window with the roll buttons opens. The buttons are on the chat card either way.

promptSound.name: Sound with a request
promptSound.hint: Plays Foundry's notification sound when a new request for your characters arrives.

gmFastForward.name: Your rolls skip the dialog
gmFastForward.hint: When you roll for a character from a card, the system's roll dialog is skipped. Hold Shift to get it anyway, or the other way round when this is off.

sceneControl.name: Button in the token controls
sceneControl.hint: Shows the request button in the token controls on the left.

Request.title: Request rolls
Request.dropHint: Drag actors from the sidebar or tokens here to add them.
Request.label: Name
Request.autoRollNpcs: Characters without a player roll at once
Request.choiceHint: Ctrl+click several rolls: players pick one.

GroupRule.half: The group succeeds when at least half succeed
GroupRule.all: The group succeeds when everyone succeeds
GroupRule.any: The group succeeds when one succeeds

Mode.gmHint: Players see only their own rolls.
Mode.blindHint: Nobody but you sees the results.

Prompt.title: Your roll
Prompt.intro: The GM asks you to roll.
Prompt.nothing: No roll is waiting for you.

Error.gmOnly: Only a GM can request rolls.
Error.unknownChoice: This roll does not exist in this game system.
Error.rollFailed: The roll for {name} failed, see the console.
Error.noRoll: No roll came from {name}. The game system does not allow it right now.

SELFTEST.Title: Self test
SELFTEST.Hint: Checks what Roll Requests needs from Foundry and the game system and reports in the chat.
SELFTEST.Generic: {system} has no own rolls in Roll Requests: requests use a formula.
SELFTEST.Untested: {system} {current} has not been checked with Roll Requests yet.
SELFTEST.NewVersions: Roll Requests was checked with older versions than {versions}. Run the self test in the module settings.
SELFTEST.Speaker: Foundry cannot name the character of a chat message.
SELFTEST.Message: Chat messages cannot be changed before they are created.
SELFTEST.NoGM: No GM is online, so results cannot be written to the cards.
SELFTEST.Choices: The rolls of {system} cannot be read.
SELFTEST.Method: The characters have no roll method {method} ({actor}).
SELFTEST.Judge: Judging a result against the DC does not work.

DEBUG.Title: Debug file
DEBUG.Hint: Saves one file for bug reports about all of Sephral’s modules in this world: versions, settings and what the modules recorded, such as the latest chat messages they read. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
DEBUG.Saved: Debug file {file} saved. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
